description:
Winter storms knock the power out. Earl shows you how to get your house and the people in it through the next one: what to do in the first hour, how to keep one room warm without the dangerous shortcuts, how to save the food in the fridge, and the cheap things worth having ready before the storm. Plain steps, in order, for older homeowners and anyone who'd rather be ready than sorry.

New videos every week.

Free large-print checklist for the first hour of an outage: https://theporchside.com/earl/free/?src=yt-earl-about
Earl's Blackout Book: https://theporchside.com/earl/blackout-book/?src=yt-earl-about

About Earl: Earl is an AI character created by Porchside, presented as a retired lineman. The guides are written and checked by the Porchside team. General home-preparedness information, not professional electrical advice. Never connect a generator to your house wiring without a transfer switch installed by a licensed electrician. In an emergency, call 911.

videos.title: The $30 Car Gadget That Runs a Lamp, a Phone and a Radio for Days When the Grid Is Down
11 Cheap Things This Old Lineman Keeps Ready for a Winter Blackout
